title: ConteXtuAlity: an open source Python package for contextuality
summary: We present an open source Python package, ConteXtuAlity, for computing various quantities related to contextuality. This package features an interface to the sheaf-theoretic framework for contextuality, providing an implementation of measurement scenarios and empirical models as well as linear programs to compute the contextual fraction and the signalling fraction. In this work, we demonstrate the package's features and give examples of its use. We also provide benchmarks, demonstrating how performances scale with the size of measurement scenarios.
